en.title: Daily Accessibility Digest – May 29, 2026
en.summary: Jefferson County launches a new website with improved navigation and accessibility features; experts warn that the 2026 World Cup raises safety and accessibility concerns; Netflix announces global expansion of its accessibility tools; and accessibility overlays are criticized as ineffective, with thousands of lawsuits filed.

highlights.title: Jefferson County Launches New Website With Improved Navigation And Accessibility
2026 World Cup sparks safety and accessibility concerns, expert says
